policy: A value is only written into the dataset when at least one source below states it explicitly. Competition/venue/date are filled from these sources; anything they do not state stays blank. Sources are classed official (governing body / league / operator), primary (official schedule or draw page of a governing body), or secondary (reputable outlet used only to corroborate).

facts: Brewers finished the regular season 103-59 and are the National League champion, sweeping the Dodgers 4-0 in the NLCS (ESPN / S-ESPN-WS).
Rays finished 98-64 and are the American League champion, beating Cleveland 4-2 in the ALCS (ESPN / S-ESPN-WS).
This is Milwaukee's first World Series appearance since 1982 and Tampa Bay's first since 2020 (S-ESPN-WS).
Washington's season opener is 21 October 2026 against Milwaukee (S-NBA-WAS).
Both teams enter 0-0: this is the first regular-season game of 2026-27 for each.
Buffalo are 4-3-2 after nine games: L 4-1 vs UTA, W 5-3 vs FLA, L 4-3 SO at MON, W 5-4 OT at TOR, L 4-3 OT at MON (S-CBS-NHL-BUF).
Philadelphia are 2-6-3 and have won their last two: 3-1 vs Ottawa and 3-2 vs Colorado (S-ESPN-NHL-PHI).
